## MGIT Becomes a Life Corporate Member of the Indian Society for Non Destructive Testing (ISNT)

News Date : 17 Oct 2026News ReportMembership strengthens MGIT’s engagement with India’s national professional body for Non-Destructive TestingGandipet, Hyderabad | October 2026Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), Gandipet, Hyderabad, has been admitted as a Life Corporate Member of the Indian Society for Non Destructive Testing (ISNT) by the society’s National Governing Council. The institute has been allotted Membership Number LCM10071, valid till October 15, 2041.ISNT is India’s national professional body dedicated to the advancement of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) and Evaluation, a field vital to the quality, safety and reliability of materials and components across industries such as manufacturing, aerospace, power, oil and gas, railways and infrastructure.The Life Corporate Membership opens up opportunities for MGIT’s students and faculty to engage with the NDT professional community through technical programmes, workshops, conferences and industry interaction. It reinforces MGIT’s commitment to industry-aligned education and to preparing students for careers in quality assurance, inspection and materials engineering.The management, Principal Prof. G. ChandraMohan Reddy, and the faculty of MGIT congratulate all those involved in securing this recognition.

Membership strengthens MGIT’s engagement with India’s national professional body for Non-Destructive Testing
Gandipet, Hyderabad | October 2026
Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), Gandipet, Hyderabad, has been admitted as a Life Corporate Member of the Indian Society for Non Destructive Testing (ISNT) by the society’s National Governing Council. The institute has been allotted Membership Number LCM10071, valid till October 15, 2041.
ISNT is India’s national professional body dedicated to the advancement of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) and Evaluation, a field vital to the quality, safety and reliability of materials and components across industries such as manufacturing, aerospace, power, oil and gas, railways and infrastructure.
The Life Corporate Membership opens up opportunities for MGIT’s students and faculty to engage with the NDT professional community through technical programmes, workshops, conferences and industry interaction. It reinforces MGIT’s commitment to industry-aligned education and to preparing students for careers in quality assurance, inspection and materials engineering.
The management, Principal Prof. G. ChandraMohan Reddy, and the faculty of MGIT congratulate all those involved in securing this recognition.
